caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular plaque with a rounded top, resembling a historical marker or tablet, centered on a plain, off-white background. The plaque appears grayish-brown, mimicking the look of aged metal or stone, and features a simple raised border around its edges. At the top of the plaque, there is a decorative double "S" or mirrored S-like symbol. Beneath this, the large letters "BLM" are inscribed in uppercase, with the central letter “L” rendered as an arrow pointing downward. Below these letters, the four numerals “1746” are arranged in a single row, referring to a date. The entire plaque is depicted with subtle shading to indicate depth and texture, while the background remains unadorned and flat.
title: Carved Date Stone
